description: Authored pass/fault examples for method review, not actual gameplay or judge calibration.

cases.observation: The interactive scene and counters match the requested initial world.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Only a menu/list or static garden illustration is present, or initial resources/sites differ.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Viewpoint changes with consistent object depth/occlusion and the garden stays usable.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: A flat image rotates without changing object depth or occlusion, or the orbit control does nothing.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: The clicked visible site, not a stale screen coordinate, receives the action at both views.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: After camera orbit the old screen coordinate affects a different plot or only a separate list can be used.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Valid placement creates exactly one pot; blocked/occupied attempts do not add a pot or charge coins.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Pots overlap, can be put on the rock or a rejected action spends money.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Purchases cost exactly two, insufficient funds reject, each valid harvest adds exactly three and arithmetic stays nonnegative.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Free/incorrectly priced pots, negative balance or unsupported rewards change the budget.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: No water means no growth; watered seed matures in the observed interval, cannot be harvested early and extra water does not instantly mature it.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: A dry/just-watered seed is harvestable, repeat water instantly matures it, or it never matures.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: One mature plant yields one reward, duplicates do nothing and the pot supports a fresh cycle.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Repeated clicks repeatedly reward an empty pot or the pot cannot be used again.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Only two supported harvests finish; completed-round operations are disabled or inert until restart.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Completion is early/absent or economic operations continue to change the finished round.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Initial state persists without old timers creating rewards/plants, and a fresh two-coin purchase works.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Old growth/rewards fire after reset, pots persist or resources/completion remain stale.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Only an attractive still image and creator claim are supplied; no corresponding input/action sequence was captured.

expected.reason: Static appearance cannot establish the required interaction.

cases.observation: The browser-control transport failed before the game could receive any ordinary input, and no artifact defect was established.

expected.reason: Evaluator infrastructure failure invalidates the measurement; it is not a game failure.
